# UA Save — Complete Documentation for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Canonical URL: https://uasave.worcco.com
> Operator: Worcco (https://worcco.com)
> Primary Purpose: High-speed, free online video downloader supporting YouTube, Instagram, TikTok (no watermark), and Facebook.

---

## 1. Overview & Service Summary
UA Save is a lightweight, high-performance web application designed for fast, secure, and intuitive video downloading across the web's largest media platforms. Operating entirely within modern web browsers, it eliminates the need for third-party executable apps, extensions, or account registrations.

---

## 2. Platform Support & Capabilities

### YouTube Downloader
- Supports regular YouTube videos, YouTube Shorts, music videos, and educational content.
- Resolutions: 360p (SD), 720p (HD), 1080p (Full HD), 1440p (2K), 2160p (4K UHD).
- Audio extraction: Direct MP3 download options.

### TikTok Downloader (No Watermark)
- Downloads short-form TikTok videos with watermark removal for pristine offline viewing.
- Supports standard TikTok links (vt.tiktok.com, vm.tiktok.com, tiktok.com/@user/video/...).
- Audio extraction in MP3 format.

### Instagram Downloader
- Downloads Instagram Reels, standard feed videos, and public IGTV clips.
- Maintains high original bitrates and MP4 compatibility across iOS, Android, and PC.

### Facebook Video Downloader
- Downloads public Facebook videos, Facebook Watch clips, and Facebook Reels in HD and SD resolutions.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Copy Link**: Find the desired video on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or Facebook and copy its URL (link).
2. **Paste Link**: Go to https://uasave.worcco.com and paste the link into the central search bar.
3. **Fetch & Preview**: Click the "Download" button or press Enter. The video title, duration, author, thumbnail, and available resolution options will appear.
4. **Download**: Choose the desired resolution or audio format to save the media file directly to device storage.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q1. What is UA Save?
UA Save is a free online video downloader that allows you to download videos from YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok in just one click — without any software, registration, or fees.

### Q2. Is UA Save free to use?
Yes! UA Save is completely free to use. There are no hidden charges, subscription fees, or premium plans.

### Q3. Which platforms does UA Save support?
UA Save currently supports YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. Additional platforms will be integrated in future updates.

### Q4. Do I need to install any software or app?
No. UA Save is a 100% browser-based tool. It works directly in web browsers on any mobile or desktop device (iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux).

### Q5. Is it safe to use UA Save?
Yes. UA Save uses secure HTTPS encryption. We do not collect, store, or sell user video links or personal data.

### Q6. What video quality options are available?
Multiple quality levels are available based on source availability, including 360p, 720p HD, 1080p Full HD, and 4K Ultra HD.

### Q7. Can I download TikTok videos without a watermark?
Yes. UA Save strips TikTok watermarks for clean, high-definition MP4 downloads.

### Q8. Can I download Instagram Reels and Stories?
Yes. UA Save supports downloading Instagram Reels, Stories, and public video posts.

### Q9. How long does it take to download a video?
Processing takes seconds on high-speed optimized backend servers.

### Q10. Do I need an account or sign-up?
No. No registration, email, or login is required.

### Q11. Is there a download limit?
No. Users have unlimited free video downloads.

### Q12. Is downloading videos legal?
UA Save is intended for personal, offline backup and fair use. Downloading copyrighted material for commercial redistribution may violate terms of service. Users should only download content they own or have permission to save.

### Q13. Who owns and operates UA Save?
UA Save is developed, owned, and operated by Worcco (https://worcco.com).
